title: Reconstructing spherical weight monoids from homogeneous additive-action weights, including half-space and torus exceptions
difficulty_reason: H2: the existing open-orbit/generalized-root dimension criterion does not reconstruct the weight monoid from the set of homogeneous additive-action weights. The author first derives the exact quasi-affine toric root-action restriction from the omitted fan faces, combines lattice points in translated cone sections with that restriction to recover each facet as an asymptotic cone and the full character lattice from root weights, and in the non-torus reductive case constructs a two-sided finite-translate sandwich using finitely generated invariant vector-field modules and replicated additive actions. The proof then reconstructs the saturated monoid and distinguishes the genuine single-ray half-space exception and empty-weight torus case. This complete geometric/lattice/invariant-theoretic construction is nonroutine and beyond ordinary qualifying-exam arguments; core lemmas and automorphism applications are supplied as one problem.
